most_similar_reason: Candidate 4 depicts water/fish-associated primordial beings who descend from the sky in a vessel, require an aquatic environment, and feed and civilize humanity, closely mirroring the Apkallu/Oannes motif of fish-men emerging from the primeval waters to bring wisdom and sustenance to humans.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 2 describes Aboriginal cloud/rain creator spirits linked to rock art and seasonal renewal rituals, sharing only the generic idea of powerful primordial beings with no parallel to sages teaching civilization, city-founding, or fish/bird hybrid forms.
